question: How are Śaiva-purified ones not liberated like others?
premises: They are in streams beyond path-order-triad and others.
inference: Śaiva-purified ones are not liberated in the same way as others, because they are in higher streams.
plain_english: As others are not properly liberated, so Śaiva-purified ones are not; they are in streams beyond path, order, triad, and others.
